summary: Kandal M Venture's wholly-owned subsidiary Padachi M filed a Form 6-K reporting mutual termination of a June 8, 2026 sale and purchase agreement with Mr. Miao Duncan and Mr. Miao Tai Wai, David covering 15% of Dumaine International Ltd, effective September 25, 2026. Instead of closing the equity purchase, Padachi M and Dumaine entered a convertible bond purchase agreement for $2.5 million principal of senior unsecured convertible bonds, 6% coupon paid semi-annually, five-year maturity. Dumaine's share capital is held 15% by Padachi M, 38.25% by Miao Duncan, 46.75% by Miao Tai Wai. Board and audit committee approved as a related-party transaction. Watch related-party execution risk and conversion terms not disclosed.
